estimates.assumptions: Standard English muffin is ~57 g each; 2 muffins total 114 g edible portion.
Modest 'to serve' amount for buttering 4 muffin halves; ~5 g per half is realistic for light spreading.
Typical smoked salmon slice is ~25 g; 8 slices total 200 g edible smoked salmon.
One large egg yolk is ~17 g; 3 yolks total 51 g. Calories based on standard raw egg yolk density (~317 kcal/100 g).
